role.zh: AI 数据与模型研发实习生

text.en: Connected financial documents, reliable data and language models. Supported RAG indicator extraction, data quality management and evaluation for financial AI products.
text.zh: 连接金融文档、可靠数据与语言模型。参与金融 AI 产品研发，支持 RAG 指标抽取、风险数据生产与质量管理、模型评估与提示词优化。

steps.en: Helped translate requirements for annual and sustainability reports into document parsing and indicator extraction workflows.
steps.zh: 围绕年报与可持续发展报告的解析需求，协助设计指标抽取流程。

steps.en: Cleaned, processed and validated multi-source financial data for a bank risk early-warning model.
steps.zh: 清洗、加工并验证多源金融数据，为银行风险预警模型建设指标数据。

steps.en: Participated in annotation, prompt iteration and model evaluation to improve retrieval and structured outputs.
steps.zh: 参与数据标注、提示词迭代与模型评估，改进检索与结构化输出。

text.en: Built automated data workflows covering 9,000+ listed companies, integrated A-share and Hong Kong market data, and supported factor analysis and index methodology research.
text.zh: 搭建覆盖 9,000+ 家上市公司的自动化数据流程，整合 A 股与港股多源数据，参与因子分析与策略指数规则研究。

steps.en: Cleaned and integrated multi-source market and non-financial data with Python and SQL; implemented three data improvement proposals.
steps.zh: 使用 Python 与 SQL 清洗整合市场及非财务数据，提出并落地三项数据优化方案。

steps.en: Automated batch data updates and communication workflows covering more than 9,000 listed companies.
steps.zh: 搭建自动化批量更新与沟通流程，覆盖 9,000+ 家上市公司。

steps.en: Supported index rule optimization and multidimensional factor analysis; contributed to an index with approximately 1.5% excess return, as reported in my experience record.
steps.zh: 参与指数规则优化与多维因子分析，支持某指数实现约 1.5% 超额收益（据个人经历记录）。

text.en: Translated rating methodologies and disclosure standards into practical indicator systems, corporate recommendations and AI-assisted monitoring workflows.
text.zh: 将评级方法论与披露标准转化为可执行的指标体系、企业改进建议与 AI 辅助监测流程。

text.en: Combined partner due diligence, budget monitoring and cross-sector coordination to support local development projects.
text.zh: 结合合作方尽职调查、预算监控与跨部门协调，支持当地发展项目。

steps.en: Conducted due diligence on four local partner organizations, covering AML, CTF, financial health and sustainability risks.
steps.zh: 对四家本地合作机构开展尽职调查，覆盖反洗钱、反恐融资、财务健康与可持续发展风险。

steps.en: Supported three projects; identified a roughly 20% cost overrun through budget and resource analysis and helped implement procurement improvements.
steps.zh: 参与三个驻地项目，通过预算与资源分析识别约 20% 成本超支，并推动采购优化等措施。

steps.en: Coordinated clean-energy and small-business projects using industry research, financial estimates and feasibility assessment.
steps.zh: 通过行业研究、财务测算与可行性评估，协调清洁能源及中小微企业项目。

name.en: International Institute of Green Finance, CUFE
name.zh: 中央财经大学国际绿色金融研究院

text.en: Researched green lending products, collateral innovation and associated risks at small and medium-sized banks.
text.zh: 研究中小银行绿色贷款产品、创新抵押方式及其风险，协助构建评价体系。

text.en: Supported two interim audits, controlled 300+ bank confirmations, and assisted with inventory aging, impairment analysis and stocktakes.
text.zh: 参与两个中报审计项目及 300+ 份银行函证控制，支持存货库龄、减值分析与监盘。

name.zh: 浙江敬业会计师事务所

text.en: Reviewed related-party transactions, interest calculations and financial statement records spanning nearly ten years.
text.zh: 核查关联方往来、利息测算与近十年财务记录，参与供应商差异分析及报表准确性核对。

context.zh: 华证指数 · 职业实践 · 2025

title.zh: 从海量反馈中找到重点

summary.en: Used Amazon Reviews ’23 to identify product pain points with topic modeling and sentiment analysis, then designed a priority score to turn feedback into an iteration roadmap.
summary.zh: 基于 Amazon Reviews ’23，通过主题建模与情感分析识别产品痛点，设计优先级评分，将反馈转化为产品迭代建议。

context.zh: 课程研究 · 2026 年 4 月

steps.en: Identify recurring themes with LDA and quantify negative sentiment across reviews.
steps.zh: 通过 LDA 识别反复出现的主题，并量化评论中的负面情绪。

steps.en: Design PPPS using frequency, negative sentiment, rating impact and helpful votes.
steps.zh: 基于频率、负面情绪、评分影响与 helpful votes 设计 PPPS 优先级模型。

steps.en: Compare customer feedback with product metadata to identify gaps between positioning and experience.
steps.zh: 对照用户反馈与产品元数据，识别宣传卖点和真实体验之间的差距。

title.zh: 在真实世界数据中识别风险

summary.en: Processed million-scale FAERS records with PySpark and HDFS to explore adverse-event patterns, population differences and monitoring priorities.
summary.zh: 使用 PySpark 与 HDFS 处理百万级 FAERS 记录，探索不良反应模式、人群差异与监测优先级。

context.zh: 课程研究 · 2025 年 12 月

steps.en: Clean and structure large-scale FAERS records in a distributed data pipeline.
steps.zh: 通过分布式数据流程清洗并结构化处理 FAERS 记录。

steps.en: Stratify by age and event severity and compare drug-ingredient / outcome combinations using risk ratios.
steps.zh: 按年龄与事件严重程度分层，使用风险比比较药物成分与结果组合。

steps.en: Communicate exploratory findings through Python visualizations. Reporting associations do not establish causation or clinical guidance.
steps.zh: 以 Python 可视化传达探索性发现；报告关联不代表因果关系或临床建议。

title.zh: 从数据看见发展的不同侧面

summary.en: Built an interactive Tableau dashboard using World Bank public data to explore national indicators, regional differences and development trends.
summary.zh: 基于世界银行公开数据制作 Tableau 交互式仪表盘，探索国家指标、地区差异与发展趋势。

steps.en: Integrate public environmental, social and governance indicators.
steps.zh: 整合公开环境、社会与治理指标。

steps.en: Use linked filters and views to explore regional differences and indicator trends.
steps.zh: 通过联动视图与筛选探索地区差异和指标趋势。
